# 1RB1LC_1LA0RE_0LD---_1RE0LF_1RF0RD_1LD0LB

bbchallenge id 166700, a BB(6) holdout (group G06). Family: **list of blocks tripled by sweeps**. Open; only partly
analysed.

| state | read 0 | read 1 |
|---|---|---|
| A | 1RB | 1LC |
| B | 1LA | 0RE |
| C | 0LD | --- |
| D | 1RE | 0LF |
| E | 1RF | 0RD |
| F | 1LD | 0LB |
## What it does

Everything happens left of the start. Write `a = 10`, `s = 01100`. At the records of the head in D at the left end
the tape is

    0^inf D> 0 a^x j a^y s a^m1 s a^m2 s ...        (j a junction cell)

* **Rounds** (`lean/Rules.lean`, generated by `lean/rules.py`): `half_round_0`: `0^inf D> 0 (10)^x 0 (10)^(y+1) R`
  -> `0^inf D> 0 (10)^(x+2) 1 (10)^y R` (4x+10 steps); `half_round_1`: `0^inf D> 0 (10)^x 1 (10)^(y+1) R` ->
  `0^inf D> 0 (10)^(x+2) 0 (10)^y R` (4x+6 steps); R is never read. `rounds` (`lean/Rounds.lean`, induction):
  (x, 0, y+2k) -> (x+4k, 0, y).
* **Rounds further in** (`lean/Rules.lean`, kernel, for all lengths and every R; `s = 01100`):
  `mid_round_0`: `0^inf D> 0 a^(a+2) s a^b 0 a^(c+1) R` -> `0^inf D> 0 a^(a+1) s a^(b+3) 1 a^c R`, 4a+4b+38 steps;
  `mid_round_1`: junction 1 -> 0, 4a+4b+34 steps; `mid_round_j_1`, `mid_round_j_2`: the same with one or two blocks
  `s a^(d+2)` between the first block and the junction's, each crossed unchanged and adding 4d+28 steps.
* **Rounds at the right end**: `tail_round`: `0^inf D> 0 a^(a+2) s a^(f+2) (1001100)^n 1 0^inf` -> the same with
  `a^(a+1)` and `(1001100)^(n+1)`, 4a+4f+24n+46 steps; `tail_round_1`, `tail_round_2` with blocks between.
* **The tripling.** With the junction in a later block every round moves one word from the block after it to the
  block before it and adds two: a block of c words that the junction passes comes back as 3c plus what was there,
  which is the 3n, 3n+8 pattern seen in the lists (3, 11 -> 9, 41 -> 35, 123; 51, 107 -> 153, 329). The first block
  pays one word a round. Not decoded yet: what happens when the junction reaches a separator, when it reaches the
  tail, and when the first block runs out; these take a bounded number of rounds each.

### The run (`c/m5fast.c`)

`m5fast` applies the three kinds of rounds in one stroke wherever they fit (also with more than two blocks between,
where the step counts follow the same pattern) and simulates the rest. Checked against the plain machine: tape and
state agree at all 13,356 records in D on the left, every jump included, up to 1.015*10^11 steps (`m5fast 12 11`,
7 minutes). From blank tape: 10^12 steps without a halt (the visited tape is then about 2*10^6 cells; 26 minutes).
The jumps save less here than for the other machines, because the junction meets a separator every few dozen
rounds and each of those rounds is a sweep of the whole tape.

## Status

Open. Lean: `lean/Blank.lean` (halting configurations, no halt in 10^4 steps by the kernel, 10^7 by
`native_decide`), `lean/Rules.lean`, `lean/Rounds.lean`. No halt to 10^12 steps (`c/m5fast.c`). The only halting
transition is C reading 1; none of the proved rounds can halt.

## For later

* Decode the junction crossing a separator, reaching the tail, and the first block running out, as rules with
  symbolic lengths; then the run becomes a map on the list of block lengths, and the jumps would cover everything.
* Prove the rounds with any number of blocks between (a list induction over crossing lemmas; symtm proves the
  cases with 0, 1, 2 blocks).

## Check

```sh
. /etc/profile.d/lean.sh && holdouts/1RB1LC_1LA0RE_0LD---_1RE0LF_1RF0RD_1LD0LB/lean/check.sh
gcc -O2 -o rec holdouts/1RB1LC_1LA0RE_0LD---_1RE0LF_1RF0RD_1LD0LB/c/rec.c && ./rec 1RB1LC_1LA0RE_0LD---_1RE0LF_1RF0RD_1LD0LB 2000000000 L 10000000 > records.txt   # the tape at each record on the left
gcc -O2 -o m5fast holdouts/1RB1LC_1LA0RE_0LD---_1RE0LF_1RF0RD_1LD0LB/c/m5fast.c
SZ=268435456 ./m5fast 12 11   # checked against the plain machine to 10^11 steps, 7 minutes
./m5fast 18                   # the long run
```
